name: public Rekor withholding every DSSE payload
note: This is what the live public instance actually does for cosign's "dsse" entry kind: it stores a payload hash, not the payload. With no payload there is no predicate, so no toolId and no previousSchemaHash — nothing to rebuild. Discover says exactly that instead of reporting an empty history as if the publisher had never signed anything.
